name: Rorak 4
description: Rorak 4 was an industrial planet that was located within the galaxy's Hutt Space region and lay on the hyperlanes called the Gamor Run and the Shag Pabol. Rorak 4 was orbited by the Rorak 5 space station and was the site of the largest slave market in the Hutt Space.
